params.name: league.draft.ledgerDraftsAhead
params.constrainedBy: C7.2.1 outputs: ledger of future picks, starting horizon 3 drafts ahead

params.name: league.draft.futureDiscountRoundsPerYear
params.constrainedBy: C7.2.3 rule 3: a future pick is discounted one round per year of delay (starting rule, Unverified practice)

params.name: league.draft.futureSlotFractionOfRound
params.constrainedBy: Assumption: a future pick whose slot is unknown is priced at this fraction through its (discounted) round, the middle by default

params.name: league.draft.chartMinStepRatio
params.constrainedBy: C7.5.1 acceptance: the chart is strictly falling; a fitted plateau is stepped down by this share of the slot before it

params.name: league.draft.udfaWeightBonus
params.constrainedBy: C7.4.1 rule 2 names the factors but not their weights; starting weight for bonus offered (share of the best offer)

params.name: league.draft.udfaWeightDepth
params.constrainedBy: C7.4.1 rule 2: depth chart ahead of him at his position; starting weight per player ahead, scaled by the deepest offer

params.name: league.draft.udfaWeightCall
params.constrainedBy: C7.4.1 rule 2 and M4.5.2: a coach's call; starting weight

params.name: league.draft.udfaWeightDistance
params.constrainedBy: C7.4.1 rule 2: distance from home; starting weight, scaled by the farthest offer

params.name: league.draft.udfaNoise
params.constrainedBy: C7.4.1 rule 2: with noise; width of the uniform noise term
